related.title: 鑽孔蓄熱場熱傳模擬
related.transfer: 可遷移「太陽能保證率」與「啟動所需的年數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；鑽孔蓄熱場熱傳模擬的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Solar fraction" and "Years needed to start up" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Borehole Thermal Energy Storage Modeling must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用夏天的太陽為冬天供暖的社區：集熱量、保證率、鑽孔蓄熱、啟動年數、管網熱損與規模效應；鑽孔蓄熱場熱傳模擬則以把一整塊岩石當成蓄熱體：鑽孔長度、蓄熱體積與容量、熱擴散、表面積比、熱響應試驗與長期漂移為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A community heated in winter by summer sun: collected heat, solar fraction, borehole storage, start-up years, network loss and the effect of scale; Borehole Thermal Energy Storage Modeling centres on using a whole block of rock as a heat store: borehole length, store volume and capacity, diffusion, surface ratio, response testing and long-term drift, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「集熱器的年集熱量」與「鑽孔的總長度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「鑽孔蓄熱體的容量」的模型移到鑽孔蓄熱場熱傳模擬，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱響應試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Yearly heat from the collectors" and "Total borehole length".
Move the model of "Capacity of the borehole store" to Borehole Thermal Energy Storage Modeling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Thermal response test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「太陽能保證率」與「啟動所需的年數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；鑽孔蓄熱場熱傳模擬的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Solar fraction" and "Years needed to start up" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Borehole Thermal Energy Storage Modeling must be respecified.

related.title: 地下含水層季節儲熱
related.transfer: 可遷移「太陽能保證率」與「啟動所需的年數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；地下含水層季節儲熱的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Solar fraction" and "Years needed to start up" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用夏天的太陽為冬天供暖的社區：集熱量、保證率、鑽孔蓄熱、啟動年數、管網熱損與規模效應；地下含水層季節儲熱則以把夏天的熱存到冬天、冬天的冷存到夏天：熱半徑、井的洩降、地下水漂移、直接冷卻與冷熱平衡為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A community heated in winter by summer sun: collected heat, solar fraction, borehole storage, start-up years, network loss and the effect of scale; Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage centres on keeping summer heat for winter and winter cold for summer: thermal radius, well drawdown, groundwater drift, free cooling and thermal balance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「集熱器的年集熱量」與「顯熱蓄熱量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「鑽孔蓄熱體的容量」的模型移到地下含水層季節儲熱，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直接冷卻的效率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Yearly heat from the collectors" and "Sensible heat storage".
Move the model of "Capacity of the borehole store" to Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Efficiency of free cooling", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「太陽能保證率」與「啟動所需的年數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；地下含水層季節儲熱的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Solar fraction" and "Years needed to start up" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 德雷克蘭丁太陽能社區
history.text: 2007 年社區的系統開始運轉；2012 年太陽能保證率達到 97%；2024 年系統因設備老化而規劃退役。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2007: The community system began operating. 2012: Solar fraction reached 97%. 2024: The system was scheduled for retirement as equipment aged. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
